Feature: System Availability and User Management

  Scenario: System Availability on Specified PinCodes
    Given the system is configured with the following PinCodes in the Parameter Control File
      | PinCode |
      | 1234    |
      | 5678    |
    When the system is accessed with a PinCode
    Then the system is available only for the specified PinCodes

  Scenario: User Login and Password Management
    Given the system is configured with user credentials
    When a user attempts to login with a valid username and password
    Then the system grants access to the user
    And the login-id/password is managed in a secured manner

  Scenario: Doctor-Specialty Mapping
    Given the system is configured with a Doctor and a Specialty
    When the Doctor is mapped to the Specialty
    Then the Doctor is linked to the Specialty
    And the Doctor is mapped to ONE and ONLY ONE Specialty

  Scenario: Doctor Consultation
    Given the system is configured with a Doctor and a Patient
    When the Doctor provides consultation to the Patient
    Then the Doctor is linked to the Patient
    And the Patient has a consultation request linked to the Doctor's Specialty

  Scenario: Patient Registration
    Given the system is configured with a Patient
    When the Patient registers themselves by filling the Patient profile
    Then a unique id is generated for the Patient
    And the Patient is registered in the system

  Scenario: Patient Consultation Request
    Given the system is configured with a Patient and a Doctor
    When the Patient requests consultation with the Doctor
    Then the Patient has a consultation request linked to the Doctor's Specialty

  Scenario Outline: System Availability on Invalid PinCodes
    Given the system is configured with the following PinCodes in the Parameter Control File
      | PinCode |
      | invalid_pin |
      | 12345    |
      | abcdef    |
    When the system is accessed with a PinCode
    Then the system is not available for the specified PinCodes

  Scenario Outline: User Login with Invalid Credentials
    Given the system is configured with user credentials
    When a user attempts to login with an invalid username and password
    Then the system denies access to the user

  Scenario Outline: Doctor-Specialty Mapping with Duplicate Mapping
    Given the system is configured with a Doctor and a Specialty
    When the Doctor is mapped to the Specialty with a duplicate mapping
    Then the system raises an error for duplicate mapping

  Scenario Outline: Patient Registration with Invalid Data
    Given the system is configured with a Patient
    When the Patient registers themselves with invalid data
    Then the system raises an error for invalid data

Feature: System Availability and User Authentication
  As a system administrator
  I want the system to be available only on specified pin codes
  So that unauthorized access is prevented

  Scenario: System Availability on Specified Pin Codes
    Given the system is configured with pin codes in the parameter control file
    When the system is accessed with a valid pin code
    Then the system is available for user authentication
    And the system denies access with an invalid pin code

  Scenario: User Authentication with Valid Credentials
    Given the system is configured with valid user credentials
    When the user attempts to login with valid credentials
    Then the user is authenticated successfully
    And the user is redirected to the dashboard

  Scenario: User Authentication with Invalid Credentials
    Given the system is configured with valid user credentials
    When the user attempts to login with invalid credentials
    Then the user is denied access
    And an error message is displayed

  Scenario: Doctor Speciality Mapping
    Given the system is configured with doctor speciality mapping
    When a doctor is assigned to a speciality
    Then the doctor is linked to the speciality
    And the speciality has one or more doctors linked to it

  Scenario: Doctor Consultation with Patient
    Given the system is configured with doctor consultation mapping
    When a doctor provides consultation to a patient
    Then the patient is linked to the doctor
    And the doctor has provided consultation to one or more patients

  Scenario: Patient Registration
    Given the system is configured with patient registration
    When a patient registers with a unique id
    Then the patient is registered successfully
    And a unique id is generated for the patient

  Scenario: Patient Consultation Request
    Given the system is configured with patient consultation request
    When a patient requests consultation with a doctor
    Then the patient is linked to the doctor
    And the doctor has received a consultation request from the patient

  Scenario Outline: System Availability on Specified Pin Codes with Examples
    Given the system is configured with pin codes in the parameter control file
    When the system is accessed with a <pin_code>
    Then the system is available for user authentication if the pin code is valid
    And the system denies access with an invalid pin code

    Examples:
      | pin_code    |
      | 1234        |
      | 5678        |
      | invalid_pin |

  Scenario Outline: User Authentication with Valid and Invalid Credentials with Examples
    Given the system is configured with valid user credentials
    When the user attempts to login with <username> and <password>
    Then the user is authenticated successfully if the credentials are valid
    And the user is denied access with an invalid password

    Examples:
      | username | password |
      | valid_user | valid_password |
      | invalid_user | valid_password |
      | valid_user | invalid_password |

  Scenario Outline: Doctor Speciality Mapping with Examples
    Given the system is configured with doctor speciality mapping
    When a doctor is assigned to a speciality with <speciality_id>
    Then the doctor is linked to the speciality if the speciality id is valid
    And the speciality has one or more doctors linked to it

    Examples:
      | speciality_id |
      | 1             |
      | 2             |
      | invalid_id    |

  Scenario Outline: Doctor Consultation with Patient with Examples
    Given the system is configured with doctor consultation mapping
    When a doctor provides consultation to a patient with <patient_id>
    Then the patient is linked to the doctor if the patient id is valid
    And the doctor has provided consultation to one or more patients

    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | 1          |
      | 2          |
      | invalid_id |

  Scenario Outline: Patient Registration with Examples
    Given the system is configured with patient registration
    When a patient registers with a unique id <patient_id>
    Then the patient is registered successfully if the patient id is valid
    And a unique id is generated for the patient

    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | 1          |
      | 2          |
      | invalid_id |

  Scenario Outline: Patient Consultation Request with Examples
    Given the system is configured with patient consultation request
    When a patient requests consultation with a doctor with <doctor_id>
    Then the patient is linked to the doctor if the doctor id is valid
    And the doctor has received a consultation request from the patient

    Examples:
      | doctor_id |
      | 1         |
      | 2         |
      | invalid_id |

attempts.artifact:
Feature: System Availability and User Management

  Scenario: System Availability by Pin Code
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    When the user attempts to access the system with pin code "1234"
    Then the system is available
    And the system displays the login page

  Scenario: System Unavailability by Pin Code
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    When the user attempts to access the system with pin code "invalid_pin"
    Then the system is unavailable
    And the system displays an error message "Invalid pin code"

  Scenario: User Login
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    And the user has a valid username "valid_user" and password "valid_password"
    When the user attempts to login with username "valid_user" and password "valid_password"
    Then the user is logged in
    And the system displays the dashboard

  Scenario: Invalid User Login
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    And the user has an invalid username "invalid_user" and password "valid_password"
    When the user attempts to login with username "invalid_user" and password "valid_password"
    Then the user is not logged in
    And the system displays an error message "Invalid username or password"

  Scenario: Doctor-Specialty Mapping
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    And there are two doctors with specialty "Cardiology" and "Dermatology"
    When the user attempts to map a doctor to a specialty
    Then the doctor is mapped to one and only one specialty
    And the system displays a success message "Doctor specialty mapping successful"

  Scenario: Patient Registration
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    And there is a patient with unique ID "patient_1"
    When the patient attempts to register
    Then the patient is registered
    And the system generates a unique ID for the patient
    And the system displays a success message "Patient registration successful"

  Scenario: Consultation Request
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    And there is a patient with unique ID "patient_1" and a doctor with specialty "Cardiology"
    When the patient attempts to request a consultation
    Then the patient is able to request a consultation
    And the system displays a success message "Consultation request successful"

  Scenario Outline: Pin Code Length and Format
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    When the user attempts to access the system with pin code "<pin_code>"
    Then the system is available
    Examples:
      | pin_code |
      | 1234     |
      | 5678     |
      | 12345    |
      | abcdef   |

  Scenario Outline: Secure Handling of Credentials
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    And the user has a valid username "valid_user" and password "valid_password"
    When the user attempts to login with username "valid_user" and password "valid_password"
    Then the user is logged in
    And the system stores the password encrypted
    Examples:
      | username | password |
      | valid_user | valid_password |
      | invalid_user | invalid_password |

  Scenario Outline: Unique Patient ID
    Given the system is configured with pin codes "1234" and "5678"
    When the patient attempts to register
    Then the system generates a unique ID for the patient
    And the system does not reuse the patient ID
    Examples:
      | patient_id |
      | patient_1  |
      | patient_2  |
      | patient_3  |
